sentences.text: After considering the documents produced and hearing the contentions raised, I am inclined to pass an interim order.
This is particularly because of Annexure B communication issued by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: In such circumstances, there shall be an interim order staying all further proceedings against the petitioners in CC.No.851/2020 on the file of the Judicial Magistrate of First Class, Ambalapuzha for a period of four months.
